contents.content:
Whitefield, an exciting part of Bangalore, is becoming more and more well-known for its nightlife. Its lively the environment combined with modern amenities creates a variety of pubs that cater to all tastes. Whitefield has everything you could possibly need, including a peaceful place to relax and a lively restaurants with live music.

Here’s a look at the top ten pubs in Whitefield that you should definitely check out. From cozy bars to craft breweries, each place has its own special vibe and attractions. Let’s dive into the best spots for a great night out in Whitefield!

History of Pubs in Whitefield

The growth of Whitefield's pub culture has a strong connection to the area's history, especially in view of the IT boom. A vibrant group of young professionals evolved as more IT companies established themselves in the area. This influx of people led to the establishment of various pubs and bars, creating a lively nightlife scene.

Whitefield was well known for its residential neighborhoods and a few nearby restaurants prior to the IT revolution. But as the need for social areas increased, so did the quantity of pubs, turning Whitefield into a hotspot for nightlife. These days, it is the location of several bars serving a variety of regional and foreign cuisines.

Top 10 Pubs in Whitefield


1. The Pump House

The Pump House has both indoor and outdoor seats with a relaxed vibe. With an element of rustic attraction, the decor is modern. The Pump House is a local favorite, renowned for its craft produces and a diverse menu with anything from Asian items to burgers.
Address: Bogineni Black SH - 35, 87/2A & 87/3, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560067.
Price:1,600 for two people (approx.) with alcohol.

The Biergarten, an outdoor the tavern with seating that is shaded in teal and gold, is an ideal spot to relax with friends and coworkers after work tires you out with its excellent craft beer and beverages. Bangalore can experience Oktoberfest all year long because to their German-style beer. It's obvious that the Hefeweizen goes nicely with their bacon-wrapped prawns. But for the ultimate way to cap off your day, their Bailey's Cheesecake would have to be the cherry on top.
Address: 2, Rd Number 2, Doddanakundi Industrial Area 2, Seetharampalya, Hoodi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048
Price:₹2,500 for two people (approx.) with alcohol.

3. Whitefield Social

People in Whitefield won't have to walk all the way into the city to enjoy some of the unusual cocktails served here, thanks to this relatively new Social. Whether it's the well-known LLIIT (Longest Long Island Iced Tea) or the Acharoska, these inventive concoctions are essentially modern takes on timeless favorites.
Address: Shop 29, Ground Floor, Phoenix Marketcity, ITPL Main Rd, Devasandra Industrial Estate, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048.
Price:₹1,500 for two people (approx.) with alcohol.

4. Windmills Craftworks

Yet another microbrewery in Whitefield, Windmills Craftworks is a must-visit if you’re in the area. While Stout, Hefeweizen, Golden Ale and India Pale Ale are their regular beer offerings, they also have seasonal variants every now and then. And, dishes like Windmills Baby Pork Ribs and Onion Rings on the grub front. Regularly hosting jazz gigs by artistes from across the world, this is a perfect place to start off your weekend.
Address: 331, 1st Floor, 2nd Main Road, 2nd Stage, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066
Price:₹3,500 for two people (approx.) with alcohol.

5. Oota Bangalore

Oota Bangalore offers a warm yet dynamic environment by blending modern and traditional designs. The pub is an excellent place to get meals because it serves a variety of continental and Indian dishes.
Address: 7th Floor, Craftworks, 331, 5B Rd, Shivaji Nagar, EPIP Zone, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066
Price:₹1,200 for two people (approx.) with alcohol.

6. Umbaa Pub and Kitchen

A popular spot for gatherings with friends, this restaurants is noted for its cozy ambiance.Perfect for a night out, Umbaa serves up a wide selection of beverages and delectable finger snacks.
Address: XQM3+949, Channasandra Main Road, Whitefield, Ambedkar Nagar, Kadugodi, Bengaluru, Karnataka
Price:₹1,500 for two people (approx.) with alcohol.

7. Hard Rock Cafe

Popular among music lovers, Whitefield gets a rock and roll atmosphere from the famous Hard Rock Cafe. It's a great spot to have dinner and listen to music, offering a cuisine full of American favorites and live music performances.
Address: Ground Floor, 40, ITPL Main Rd Unit no.G-25 & 26, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066
Price:₹2,000 for two people (approx.) with alcohol.

8. Sky Garden

This Bar is a great place to spend a romantic evening because it offers beautiful city views. Sky Garden has a diverse menu with meals from several cultures and is well-known for its refreshing drinks.
Address: Metro station, 3rd floor HVP Aster, ITPL Main Rd, near Garudacharpalya, Kaveri Nagar, Krishnarajapuram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048
Price:₹2,000 for two people (approx.) Without alcohol.

9.Lord of the Drinks

Lord of the Drinks, one of India's biggest pub chains, is present in all of the nation's main cities. Featuring 300 seats spread over 4,000 square feet, it's one of the biggest bars with dance floors in Whitefield. Another option for individuals looking for inexpensive bars in Whitefield is Lord of the Drinks.
The cuisine scene is distinctive, with carefully selected dishes created from a creative fusion of seasonal and fresh ingredients, even if it is reasonably priced. It's one of the top pubs around Whitefield for antique lovers because of its vintage decor, unusual interiors, classic flavors.
Address:Phoenix Marketcity, UG 70A N FF 69A,EAST, व्हाइटहफील्ड मेन मार्ग, Krishnarajapuram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048
Price:₹1,700 for two people (approx.) with alcohol.

10.Fox in the Field

Their motto is "Delicious food, good company, and beer." Fox in the Field is one of the pubs around Whitefield with dance floors where you can get real beer and the best social drinking around. The term itself reflects the culture of British pubs. Their collaboration with English Craft Brew Company (ECB) and several well-known brands is the key to their ability to provide the greatest brewery. 

Fox in the Field has been serving Bangaloreans since 2019. The Times of India, The New Indian Express, and Economic Times have all profiled this nightclub, which is one of the few in Whitefield, Bangalore.
Address: 2/ 3/ 4/ 5 Floor, Nexus Shantiniketan Mall, ITPL Main Rd, Thigalarapalya, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560067
Price:₹2,000 for two people (approx.) with alcohol.

Events and Entertainment

Events  held in Whitefield's pubs includes karaoke nights, live music, and themed parties. Every visit is made unforgettable by these events,
For Example: Whitefield Socials known for its exciting DJ , while Windmills Craftworks frequently hosts live jazz concerts.

excerpt: Explore the top pubs in Whitefield, Bangalore for a fantastic night out with great drinks, lively atmospheres, and excellent service.
